title.en: An Act Granting a Life Pension to General Emilio Aguinaldo.

text.en:
There is hereby granted to General Emilio Aguinaldo, in recognition of the services rendered by
him to the cause of the Philippine Revolution, a life pension of twelve thousand pesos, to be paid in monthly
installments at the end of each month, out of the appropriation made in section 1-D-91 of Act Numbered
Twenty-eight hundred and seventy-five.

The sum necessary to pay the pension provided for in this Act shall be appropriated in the
General Appropriation Act each year.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 24, 1920.
